description: Returns a link to the demo request form, prefilled with the details given. Use it outside the browser when the buyer wants a demo or to talk to the team. Opening the link shows the filled form: the person, or their browser agent, sends it, then the person picks and confirms the time slot in the calendar. Sends nothing by itself. To try the product alone, use demarrer_essai.

email.description: Work email address of the person. Personal mailboxes (Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo…) are refused.

langue.description: Language of the buyer's question (en, fr, es): always pass it, the pages and answers are in this language.

name: demander_demo
title: Prepare a demo request link
